text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, T.M. Opera O receives a fan
letter.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is superb!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold, Trainer! A devout fan has
bestowed a
most fitting portrait unto
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shows me a crayon drawing probably
made
by a little kid.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's of T.M. Opera O,
for sure... though it looks
more like a tube with ears and a
tail. There's also a bunch of indigo-blue
scribbles in the background.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This sleek, elongated physique. The
irresistible
charm of my ears and tail...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think, such a prodigy who can
capture my
majestic allure exists!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And... Yes, yes... This indigo must
represent outer
space.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My silhouette bounding across the
galaxy! This
youth possesses excellent
taste!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am duty bound to make their vision a
reality!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Have you a regimen to prepare
me for
striding through the stars?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah, I am always serious.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will rise to meet the hopes and dreams
of the people, no matter what they may
be. As with
everything, one doesn't
know until one tries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some research, I explain what
kinds of
astronaut training would be
doable here at
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? But that is no different from our
usual
regimen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wait! That could mean but one thing...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have been training to reach the stars
all
along!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! I never miss the mark!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The time to take my first step toward
space has
come. I shall see that young
girl's wish granted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With eyes unwavering—as usual—T.M.
Opera O
declares her new objective.
